patterns.name: blocking_to_nonblocking
patterns.trigger: blocking assignment in sequential always block
patterns.description: Replace '=' with '<=' for all signal assignments inside edge-triggered always blocks

patterns.name: add_default_case
patterns.description: Add a default branch to prevent latch inference

patterns.name: fix_sensitivity_list
patterns.trigger: manual sensitivity list in combinational logic
patterns.description: Replace manual sensitivity list with @(*) for combinational blocks

patterns.name: add_async_reset
patterns.trigger: sequential block missing async reset in sensitivity
patterns.description: Add posedge rst to sensitivity list for asynchronous reset
patterns.example_after:
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) q <= 0;

patterns.name: fix_width_mismatch
patterns.trigger: assignment between signals of different widths
patterns.description: Add explicit bit-select or extension to match widths

patterns.name: remove_multiple_drivers
patterns.trigger: signal driven by multiple always blocks
patterns.description: Consolidate all assignments to the signal into a single always block
patterns.example_before:
always @(posedge clk) q <= d1;
always @(posedge clk) q <= d2;

patterns.name: add_else_branch
patterns.trigger: if without else in combinational always block
patterns.description: Add else branch or pre-assign default to prevent latch inference
patterns.example_after:
always @(*) begin
    out = 0;  // default
    if (en) out = data;
end

patterns.name: fix_operator_misuse
patterns.trigger: assignment operator = used in conditional where comparison == intended

patterns.name: fix_literal_radix
patterns.trigger: bare integer used where sized binary/hex literal intended
patterns.description: Add explicit width and radix to literal

patterns.name: fix_data_type
patterns.trigger: continuous assign to reg or procedural assign to wire
patterns.description: Change signal type to match assignment context

patterns.name: fix_module_name_typo
patterns.trigger: instantiated module name does not match any defined module
patterns.description: Correct the module name to match the definition

patterns.name: fix_missing_port
patterns.trigger: module instantiation missing one or more port connections
patterns.description: Add missing port connections to instantiation

patterns.name: fix_port_name_mismatch
patterns.trigger: named port in instantiation does not match module definition
patterns.description: Use exact port names from the module definition

patterns.name: positional_to_named_ports
patterns.trigger: positional port connection with potential order mismatch
patterns.description: Convert positional to named port connections to prevent order errors

patterns.name: fix_precedence_error
patterns.trigger: bitwise operator where logical operator intended, or missing parentheses
patterns.description: Use && || for boolean logic, add parentheses around comparisons

patterns.name: fix_infinite_loop
patterns.trigger: forever/while/for without termination or FSM deadlock state
patterns.description: Add termination condition or FSM exit transition
patterns.example_after: ERROR: if (clear) state <= IDLE; else state <= ERROR;
